title: Forgotten Island
plot_overview: Two high school graduates and best friends are transported through a mysterious portal to a fantastical island filled with magical creatures. To find their way home, they must face a difficult cost tied to the memories that bind them, while seeking help and a way to leave before their friendship slips away.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like heartfelt fantasy adventures, lively humor, and stories celebrating Filipino folklore and friendship; Not for you if you prefer a slower pace or less visually busy animation.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt friendship story; lively visuals; Filipino folklore | Cons: very fast pace; busy visuals; some extra characters
